<div align="center">

# 🤝 CODE OF CONDUCT

<a name="top"></a>

**How everyone who works on this vault treats each other and its owner's data.**

_Respect for the people, discretion for their data._

</div>

---

## 💡 Our Pledge

This project is a personal system, and it may be worked on by its owner, by invited collaborators
and by AI agents. Whoever is at the keyboard, we pledge to keep this a respectful,
harassment-free space, and to act in ways that keep the project healthy and its owner's trust
intact.

---

## ✅ Our Standards

Behavior that keeps this project healthy:

- Being respectful of differing viewpoints, and of the owner's final say
- Giving and accepting constructive feedback in good faith
- Owning mistakes, correcting them, and recording what was learned
- Putting first what is best for the system and the person it serves

Behavior that is not welcome:

- Harassment, insults or demeaning comments of any kind
- Publishing anyone's private information without explicit permission
- Treating the owner's personal data as anything other than confidential
- Any conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate

---

## 🧭 Scope

This code applies in all project spaces, and whenever someone represents the project in public.
It applies equally to people and to any AI agent working in this repository, which is also bound
by [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).

---

## ⚖️ Enforcement

Concerns may be reported to the project owner through
[their GitHub profile](https://github.com/tannergolden). Every report is reviewed and handled with
discretion. The owner is the final authority on enforcement and may take any action they judge
right, up to removing a contributor's access.
